cands.name: Jay Trumbull
cands.bio: Republican state senator for District 2 since 2022. Born in Panama City in 1989; Auburn University graduate; worked in management at his family's bottled water and water conditioning business. Served in the Florida House (District 6) 2014-2022, including as Appropriations chair.
cands.local_ties: Born in Panama City, Bay County; attended Bay High School (Wikipedia). Senate district office is in Panama City.

record.text: Florida House member for District 6 (Panama City), Nov 2014 to Nov 2022; Florida Senate District 2 since Nov 8, 2022.
Reported in search summaries of Wikipedia/Florida House records as having chaired the House Appropriations Committee for two years; not confirmed on the page fetched.

endorsements.text: Endorsed Jake Johansson in the open Senate District 8 race (reported by Florida Politics via the Florida Senate).

cands.gaps: No donor reporting or controversies found in the sources reached. Campaign site and social links not found. Owner-source search (combined with Donahoo) returned no hits.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
Building Safety (condo safety response after Surfside).

cands.name: Lauren Donahoo
cands.bio: Licensed practical nurse and public health professional with about 20 years in Florida health care. Currently a nurse at the Panhandle Comprehensive Treatment Center; earlier a nursing-home unit manager and a contact tracer for the Santa Rosa County health department. Master of Public Health, University of West Florida.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Milton (Santa Rosa County) with her family, per her campaign site. Degrees from Pensacola State College and the University of West Florida.

record.text: No prior elected office found. Worked as a COVID contact tracer for the Santa Rosa County Department of Health and managed a nursing-home COVID unit (campaign biography).

money_notes.text: Her campaign site says it is funded by nurses, working families and other individual supporters rather than big money (campaign claim, not checked against filings).

endorsements.text: Engage, Y'all, a group backing Democrats in rural and overlooked districts (listed on her campaign site).
